name: Rindou Rina
source: Yuuki's childhood friend, whom Yuuki parts from to enter the Private Falneze AS, and met again as he is transferred to Kouryo Academy. As a novice magician, she yearns to become a world-renowned "Teen idol Magician". She is warmhearted, popular among friends but picky only to Yuuki.
